title: Self-service RBAC delegations and periodic attestation for regional tenants
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description:
Problem: Customers operating in regulated regions require tenant-scoped access controls, delegated local admins, and auditable periodic attestations that are exportable as signed evidence. Current RBAC is centralized and lacks self-service delegation, SCIM recon runs are noisy for large orgs, and there is no first-class attestation workflow tied to SAML/SCIM identity sources.

Scope: 1) Implement tenant-scoped RBAC 'delegation' role that can be granted by org owners to grant-scoped responsibilities (user management, group sync, access attestations) without giving global admin privileges. 2) Build a periodic attestation workflow (configurable cadence, reminders, and attest/waive UI) that ties to SCIM groups and generates verifiable evidence exports. 3) Harden SCIM reconciliation to detect orphaned accounts and provide automated remediation suggestions; add a reconciler mode that emits signed evidence snapshots into a compliance S3 bucket. 4) Ensure SAML enforcement hooks (session expiry and JIT re-auth) are compatible with delegation flows.

Out of scope: full SAML IdP integrations work (we will use existing SAML connector), migrations of legacy orgs will be handled via data migration ticket, and advanced approval chains (separate ticket).

Design decisions/trade-offs: - Add a narrowly-scoped 'Tenant Admin (delegated)' role vs expanding org-owner role to avoid privilege creep. - Use email reminders + in-app banners for attestations (scales better than forced popups). - Evidence exports will be immutable, time-stamped JSON with PGP-signature for now (we may add long-term archival formats later).

Success metrics: - 80% of customers with regional tenancy can configure delegation roles without support. - Reduction of orphaned accounts flagged by SCIM by 60% after first reconciliation run. - Evidence exports generated for attestation runs complete within 60s for orgs <= 10k users.
acceptance_criteria: Tenant-scoped 'Delegated Admin' role exists and is visible in RBAC UI
Org owners can grant delegation via console and via API (PATCH /orgs/:id/roles)
Periodic attestation workflow can be scheduled, sends reminder emails, and records responses (attest/waive) in audit log
SCIM reconciler can run in dry-run and enforce mode; produces a signed evidence snapshot to the compliance S3 bucket
Evidence export includes: snapshot of group membership, list of changes detected, reconciliation actions taken, timestamp, and PGP signature
SAML session hooks respect delegated role operations and require re-auth when changing high-privilege settings
Documentation (console help + API docs) and a runbook for support are published
Automated tests covering RBAC delegation lifecycle, SCIM reconciliation edge cases, and attestation flow exist in CI
tasks: Schema: extend roles table with tenant_scope and delegatable boolean
API: add grant/revoke endpoints for delegated role; update policy checks
Console: delegation UX flows (grant dialog, revoke, audit view)
Attestation Engine: scheduler, reminder emails, UI to complete attest/waive
SCIM: improve reconciliation algorithm, implement dry-run vs enforce, add evidence exporter
Evidence: implement signer service to produce PGP-signed JSON snapshots and upload to compliance bucket
SAML: validate session expiry and JIT re-auth on privilege elevation paths
E2E: create test harness and run for org sizes: small (<=100), medium (1k-10k), large (10k+)
Docs & Runbook: write admin guide, support playbook, and incident remediation steps

qa_steps: Create a test org with tenant region EU and 2 owners; grant 'Delegated Admin' to a user and verify limited permissions
Trigger SCIM dry-run reconciliation and verify expected orphaned list and no destructive actions
Schedule an attestation run; confirm reminder email received and response recorded in audit log
Run evidence export and validate PGP signature matches public key in key registry and JSON includes required fields
Simulate SAML session expiry and verify re-auth required when changing delegation grants
